package_info.why_malicious: The package contains malicious code that reads sensitive LevelDB files from popular browsers (Chrome, Opera, Yandex, Brave) and the Discord application, then exfiltrates their contents to a hardcoded Discord webhook via HTTPS POST requests. This results in theft of credentials and private user data without user consent.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (upon import or execution of the main package file)
execution_context.file_location: main JavaScript file of the fallguys package
required_permissions: filesystem (read access to user profile directories)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime (upon import or execution), the code reads LevelDB files from browser and Discord application directories, then transmits their contents via HTTPS POST requests to a hardcoded Discord webhook, resulting in exfiltration of sensitive user data.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The code programmatically accesses LevelDB files from browser and Discord storage locations and sends their raw contents to an external Discord webhook without user knowledge or consent. This behavior is indicative of credential theft and unauthorized data exfiltration.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A legitimate npm package, especially one purporting to be related to a game, should not access or transmit browser or Discord storage files. Accessing these files and sending them to a third-party service is a clear violation of user privacy and security expectations.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate backup or migration tools may access browser data, but only with explicit user consent and never transmit such data to hardcoded third-party webhooks. Security tools may scan these files locally, but do not exfiltrate them.
key_indicators: Direct access to browser and Discord LevelDB file paths
Automated outbound HTTPS POST requests to Discord webhook endpoints
Hardcoded Discord webhook URL in code
No user interaction or consent for file access or data transmission
Reads and transmits raw LevelDB file contents

attack_chain.action: Upon importing or executing the fallguys package, the malicious code in the main JavaScript file is triggered automatically.
attack_chain.leads_to: The code initiates access to sensitive files on the user's system.

attack_chain.action: The code reads LevelDB files from Chrome, Opera, Yandex, Brave, and Discord local storage directories, extracting potentially sensitive data such as credentials and session tokens.
attack_chain.leads_to: Collected sensitive data is prepared for exfiltration.

attack_chain.action: The contents of these files are sent via HTTPS POST requests to a hardcoded Discord webhook endpoint controlled by the attacker.
attack_chain.leads_to: Exfiltrated data becomes accessible to the attacker via the Discord webhook.

behavioral_signatures: Node.js packages accessing browser or Discord LevelDB files in user profile directories
Automated outbound HTTPS POST requests to Discord webhook endpoints from non-Discord clients
Presence of hardcoded Discord webhook URLs in package source code
File access patterns targeting browser and Discord storage directories without user interaction
network_indicators: discord.com/api/webhooks/* (unexpected POST requests from non-Discord clients or npm packages)
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for npm packages that access browser or Discord LevelDB files and initiate outbound HTTPS POST requests to Discord webhook endpoints. Flag any package that reads these files without explicit user action or consent, especially if network exfiltration is involved. Review package contents for hardcoded references to Discord webhook URLs and suspicious file access patterns. Correlate file access events with network activity to detect automated exfiltration attempts.
